SELECT CD_COMPANY, CD_PARTNER, LN_PARTNER NM_PARTNER, CD_ACCT, NM_ACCT, CD_CC, NM_CC, AM_JDDJAN AS P_AMOUNT, AM_DR, AM_CR, AM_DDJAN AS N_AMOUNT FROM NEOE.V_VENDORRPT_TODAY A WHERE CD_ACCT IN ('1111010', '1111020', '1111030', '1111110', '1111120', '2141000') AND CD_COMPANY = #CD_COMPANY# ORDER BY CD_CC, CD_PARTNER, CD_ACCT

SELECT DTS_INSERT, DTS_JOBDATE, ID_USER, CD_JOB, CD_COMPANY, CD_PARTNER, NO_DEPOSIT, CD_BANK, NM_DEPOSIT, USE_YN, NO_DEPOSIT_N, CD_BANK_N, NM_DEPOSIT_N, USE_YN_N FROM NEOE.MA_PARTNER_DEPOSIT_LOG WHERE NVL(USE_KEP,'N') = 'N' AND CD_JOB IN ('I','U') AND CD_COMPANY = #CD_COMPANY# AND ( (CD_JOB = 'I' AND NVL(USE_YN_N,' ') = ' ') OR (CD_JOB = 'U' AND USE_YN_N = 'Y') ) AND ( ( nvl(CD_BANK,' ') != nvl(CD_BANK_N,' ') ) OR ( nvl(USE_YN,' ') != nvl(USE_YN_N,' ') ) OR ( nvl(NO_DEPOSIT,' ') != nvl(NO_DEPOSIT_N,' ') ) OR ( nvl(NM_DEPOSIT,' ') != nvl(NM_DEPOSIT_N,' ') ) )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE NEOE.MA_PARTNER_DEPOSIT_LOG SET USE_KEP = #RTN_FLAG# , DTS_KEPDATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DTS_INSERT = #DTS_INSERT# AND DTS_JOBDATE = #DTS_JOBDATE# AND ID_USER = #ID_USER# AND CD_JOB = #CD_JOB# AND CD_COMPANY = #CD_COMPANY# AND CD_PARTNER = #CD_PARTNER#

sqlMap.select: SELECT YY_ACCT, CD_COMPANY, CD_PARTNER, CD_ACCT,CD_CC, M01, M02, M03, M04, M05, M06, M07, M08, M09, M10, M11, M12 FROM NEOE.V_FI_Z_KEP_VENDORRPT_AGING_CC WHERE CD_COMPANY = #CD_COMPANY# AND CD_PARTNER = #CD_PARTNER# AND CD_ACCT IN ('1111010', '2141010', '2141000') AND YY_ACCT IN ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), TO_CHAR( ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12) , 'YYYY') ) AND CD_CC = '402220' ORDER BY YY_ACCT, CD_PARTNER, CD_ACCT
